#include "parser.h" // after an include
#pragma once /* after a pragma */
#define LIMIT 10 // after an object macro
#define RULE (BASE u"Katakana; NFKC")  // after a string in a macro
#define MARKER "/* not a comment */" // after a string holding a marker
#define SLASH '/' /* after a char */
#define NEXT(x) ((x) + 1) /* after a function macro */
#define LOOP(x) \
    do { (x); } while (0) /* after a continued macro */
#if defined(DEBUG) // after an if
#elif TRACE /* after an elif */
#else // after an else
#endif /* after an endif */
